segments.text: We first tried Data analytics dashboard in 209. At the time, competition mattered because we needed visibility across branches.
The biggest issue was High generator cost. Without steady power in Aba, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Data analytics dashboard—we saw Customer retention within 10 months.
Policy-wise, Data protection shaped our move. We adjusted by Partnership with fintech.
Data helped; even a Excel-based trendline gave us clearer demand patterns during Easter.
